categories.main_business_segments: Nagano Keiki operates four main business segments: pressure gauges, pressure sensors, measurement and control equipment, and die-casting. The group manufactures and sells these products, with pressure gauges and sensors forming the core of its business. It also engages in related businesses such as real estate leasing and automotive electrical components through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include the design and manufacture of Bourdon tube pressure gauges, pressure detection mechanisms, and pressure sensor elements. It emphasizes continuous R&D in high-precision measurement, digitalization (e.g., IO-Link, wireless sensors), and the development of specialized sensors for extreme environments (e.g., high/low temperature, high pressure). Production methods focus on advanced manufacturing, process integration, and the use of proprietary materials and custom ASICs for sensor signal processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nagano Keiki serves a diverse range of industrial customers, including those in factory automation (FA), construction machinery, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, social infrastructure, automotive, and process industries. Its products are essential for production equipment and activities across these sectors, with growing demand in hydrogen, ammonia, and medical fields.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint, with major operations in Japan, the United States, Europe (notably Germany), China, and other parts of Asia and the Americas. Overseas sales account for about half of total revenue, and the group operates manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nagano Keiki operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier, providing finished measurement and control products, sensors, and components to OEMs and end-users in various industries. It also manufactures some upstream components (e.g., sensor elements, die-cast parts) internally or through group companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening competitiveness in existing businesses, expanding globally (especially in North America, China, and Europe), and developing new business domains such as hydrogen and decarbonization. R&D focuses on digitalization, high-precision and high-reliability sensors, IoT-enabled products, and sustainability (GHG reduction, ESG initiatives). The company is also investing in production capacity and DX (digital transformation).
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured products (pressure gauges, sensors, control equipment, die-cast parts) to industrial customers. Additional income streams include after-sales services, calibration, real estate leasing, and, increasingly, subscription-based cloud monitoring services for IoT-enabled devices.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nagano Keiki positions itself as a leading global supplier in the pressure measurement and control field, competing with both domestic and international manufacturers. Key competitors include Ashcroft (now part of the group), WIKA, Yokogawa, and other specialized sensor and instrumentation companies. The company emphasizes its technological leadership, product breadth, and global reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 69.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 7.65 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 6.05 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profits over the past five years, maintains a strong balance sheet (equity ratio 58.8%), and continues to invest in R&D and production capacity for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nagano Keiki differentiates itself through high-precision, high-reliability measurement solutions tailored to diverse and demanding industrial applications. Its strengths include advanced sensor technology, digital and IoT integration, global manufacturing and support, and a commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability. The company emphasizes its ability to deliver customized solutions for emerging markets such as hydrogen energy and semiconductor manufacturing.
